Coram : VINEET SARAN, S. RAVINDRA BHAT
Consumer Protection Act, 1986: s.38 – Deficiency in service – Respondents booked flats with the appellant-builder – Flats were not delivered on time – Consumer complaint filed before National Commission claiming refund of money – Notices issued in June 2020 and statement/ reply filed by appellant on 31 August 2020 which was beyond the period of 45 days – National Commission declined to take the written statement on record on the ground that Consumer Court has no power to extend the time for filing the response to the complaint beyond 45 days
Decision Date : 17-12-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4085/2020 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
